headline: DC Comics announces Batman: Shadow of the Bat
post:
Get ready for a bold shift in Gotham City. According to Screen Rant, DC has officially unveiled Batman: Shadow of the Bat, a new project from the Eisner-winning creative team Deniz Camp and Javier Rodríguez. 

The creative duo is reportedly bringing the vivid visual style from Absolute Martian Manhunter straight into the Caped Crusader's world, featuring bold pop-art color blocking and panel layouts instead of a modern noir aesthetic. The story reportedly kicks off when an explosion at an abandoned ACE Chemical plant releases a toxic green cloud, forcing a neighborhood quarantine and plunging residents into mutation and madness as Batman investigates.

Will you be picking up this new series when it launches? 🦇🎨📚

#Batman #DCComics #ShadowOfTheBat
original_title: DC Officially Confirms 2027 Batman Project With First Look

headline: The Toxic Avenger: 1984 punk rock hero
post:
Long before modern comic book blockbusters dominated screens, Troma Entertainment released an R-rated superhero film in 1984 called The Toxic Avenger. Co-directed by Lloyd Kaufman and Michael Herz, the movie was made on a shoestring budget well under one million dollars. Initially struggling to find theaters, it eventually found an audience and launched a cult franchise.

Further updates regarding the film and its history will follow.

headline: Christian Bale asked about Batman before Nolan
post:
Long before Christopher Nolan's reboot was officially announced, Christian Bale had already asked his agent to watch out for a Batman movie. According to /Film, the actor grew so obsessed with landing the role that by the time casting actually happened, he felt the part was already his. He even admitted that if anyone had told him no, he would have refused to accept it! 

Before taking on the cape in "Batman Begins," Bale dived into classic comics like "Batman: Year One" and "The Long Halloween." Reading those iconic stories helped him realize the hero was far darker than he previously knew. That preparation clearly paid off, helping him craft one of the most definitive portrayals of Bruce Wayne in superhero cinema history. 

What is your absolute favorite scene from "Batman Begins"? 

#ChristianBale #BatmanBegins #DCComics
original_title: Christian Bale Pushed To Play Batman Before Christopher Nolan's Reboot Was Announced
